findings: The exact late owner-start failure tuple does not require its event-zero successful sentinel wait or a cleanup trigger strictly after the sentinel deadline; omission, post-trigger status substitution and backdating are accepted.
Both sentinel and real-owner null-timeout joins ignore a later contradictory observed birth or parent before the positive direct reap.
A null-birth adopted reap of the sentinel PID can be followed by new positive observations and a second direct reap because retirement is tracked only as a PID/birth tuple.
SPAWN_FAILED accepts a fabricated direct timeout for an arbitrary absent owner PID.
